note: golden-04.html is a profile form showing recurrence and the date-of-birth picker. The mobile and website fields both declare the text type, and two flagged fields in one form make every one of them severity 3 (FORMS-INPUT-TYPE). The date of birth is picked from three drop-downs whose year list offers 40 real options, more than the 30 that only a date far in the past needs, so FORMS-DATE-SELECTS is 3. First and last name fields split one name (FORMS-SPLIT-ENTITY, one split value, 2). The required mobile field says beside it that it is used only to text about bookings, which is why FORMS-PHONE-REASON stays silent here.
